newsitem.title: USA: CBOT grain/soy turn firm late as Sep contracts up.
newsitem.headline: CBOT grain/soy turn firm late as Sep contracts up.

text.p: CBOT grain and soybean futures were turning firm in late trading with the market led by the strength in the September contracts, traders said.
"The Sep is strong and there's expiration tomorrow with big open interest," a trader said.
The CBOT September contracts are slated to expire Wednesday at 1201 CDT.
At 1300 CDT, wheat was five to nine cents per bushel higher, with September up nine at $4.32-1/2. Corn was 1/4 to 3-1/2 cents per bushel up, with September up 3-1/2 at $3.54-3/4.
Soybeans were 2-1/2 cents higher to three lower, with September up 2-1/2 at $7.17-1/2.
